authority.user_scope: The user explicitly encouraged parallel code and art lanes, including placeholder-safe implementation where dependencies allow.
authority.verified_basis: The tech readiness audit found F0 contains projection, typed primitives, canonical serialization, palette application, and SVG rendering foundations only; it does not need promoted concept geometry or placeholders.
authority.supersedes: The final-art-digest prerequisite only for F0. A0 remains mandatory before M0, G0-G6, I0, placement, interaction integration, browser proof, or 3D work.

required_behavior: Typed exhaustive geometry primitives and deterministic canonical payload serialization
Frozen true-isometric projection and testable projection helpers
Employer palette application separated from canonical geometry identity
A small compositional SVG geometry renderer with explicit data flow
Foundation assertions added only to the existing Career World test file
must_not_encode: Any concept PNG as a runtime asset
Any unpromoted asset silhouette, trace panel, placement coordinate, city layout, or project identity
Any placeholder geometry presented as canonical
Any gesture, camera-state, drawer, overlay, responsive, browser-proof, or 3D behavior

implementation_rules: Use repository-local TypeScript and React patterns; add no dependency.
Prefer explicit discriminated unions and pure functions over abstraction layers.
Canonical geometry hashes must exclude employer palette and instance placement.
Renderer output must remain deterministic for the same geometry and palette inputs.
Do not modify files outside owned_paths, run a formatter over unrelated files, or alter art/queue/ledger/Git state.
verification: Independent code review before F0 acceptance
stop_conditions: Any C0 predecessor receipt drifts before dispatch.
F0 requires promoted art, placeholder geometry, a new dependency, or an out-of-scope runtime edit.
Any non-owned/protected path changes during the lane.
A required verification gate fails because of the F0 change.
